Footle: Daily Soccer Player Guessing Game

Guess the mystery soccer player in 8 tries. Each guess reveals clues about the player's club, league, nationality, position, and age. One of 100+ free sports games on DoUKnowBall.

Footle gives you 8 guesses to name a mystery soccer player. Each guess is a real player, and colored tiles compare it to the answer across eight attributes, from club to kit number.

You get eight goes at one mystery player and every guess comes back colour coded: arrows say whether the answer is older, scores more, or wears a higher number. Everyone gets the same new player every day.

How to play Footle, a free daily soccer guessing game
Typing a name from the suggestions
Type a player's name and pick him from the suggestions.
Reading the color coded tiles
Read the tiles: green is an exact match, yellow is close, white is a miss.
Following the up or down arrows
Follow the arrows: up means the answer's value is higher than your guess.
Narrowing by continent, league and position
Narrow by continent, league, and position group before sweating exact numbers.
SOLVING WITHIN YOUR EIGHT GUESSES
Get the name within 8 guesses and share your emoji grid.
Footle rules: guesses, yellow tiles and the difficulty tiers
Eight guesses in every mode
You get 8 guesses in both daily and unlimited mode.
What counts as a close yellow tile
Yellow means close: same continent, same league, within 3 goals, assists, or kit number, within 2 years of age, within 5 million dollars of value, or the same position group.
Daily difficulty split and unlimited choice
The daily tier is shared: about 40 percent of days are Easy, 55 Hard, 5 Insane.

value.help:
How to Play Footle

Guess the mystery soccer player in 8 tries!

🎨 Color Guide
Green: Exact match!
Yellow: Close, see thresholds below.
White: Not a match.
📏 "Close" Thresholds
🌍 Nationality: Same continent
🏟️ Club: Same league = yellow
⚽ Goals: Within 3
👟 Assists: Within 3
📍 Position: Same group (Def/Mid/Fwd)
👕 Kit Number: Within 3
📅 Age: Within 2 years
💰 Market Value: Within $5M
🔼 Arrow Hints

▲ means the answer is higher, ▼ means it's lower.

⚙️ Difficulty Modes
Easy: The 80 most valuable players in the world right now, plus the all-time greats
Hard: Squad & rotation names from big clubs
Insane: Genuinely obscure pros: second divisions, smaller leagues, deep squads
